name: kemik.gt
body: Every page has a title, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 4 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.
lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.
summary: Partial analysis: 18 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.kemik.gt scores 77 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 23 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: 4 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 4 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Perplexity-User (Perplexity, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, DuckAssistBot (DuckAssist answers) by Disallow: /, MistralAI-User (Le Chat, when a person asks it to open a page) by…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 2 session cookies are readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: anonymous_request_count, kemik-session-id, kemik-session-is-user. Without HttpOnly: kemik-session-id, kemik-session-is-user. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /amazon.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 62 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 2 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 page names another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /amazon → /. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 6 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 278 ms
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
